_comment: Presets (sysex.md 4.5): PRESET_INFO 0x0B, PRESET_SAVE 0x0C, PRESET_RESET 0x0D, PRESET_NAME 0x0E,
PRESET_CHANGED 0x63; select = SET_PARAM preset.active (id 17). HELLO caps bit 5 = presets.
PRESET_INFO reply: status, slot u14, count u14, active u14, flags (1 stored edits, 2 dirty, 4 YAML),
revision u14, stored_revision u14, program s32 (-1 = none), name string (u8 len 0..16 + ASCII).
schema: an example with the PRESET flag (bit 5 = 32) on per-preset params, and params 17..19.

_comment: Host feedback (sysex.md 4.6): GET_COMPONENT 0x11 (HELLO caps bit 6 = 64); notifications 0x20-0x3F
(FB_LED 0x20, FB_LED_RGB 0x21, FB_LEDS 0x22, FB_VALUE 0x23, FB_RING 0x24, FB_TEXT 0x25, FB_RELEASE 0x26)
are never answered; seq is ignored (the host tool sends 0).
GET_COMPONENT reply: status, kind, index u14, count u14, id, name, role (lstring: u8 len 0..31 + ASCII),
then by kind: 1 button led u14 | 2 keys keys u14, first_note | 3 analog - | 4 encoder ring, center u14 |
5 LED colours | 6 display cols, rows, type. 0x3FFF = no LED (fields show it as null).
Added fields, one byte each after those: analog takeover (0 none, 1 pick-up), encoder mode (0 absolute,
1 relative two's complement, 2 relative offset, 3 Mackie V-Pot), LED owner (0 host_then_local, 1 host,
2 local). Older firmware leaves them out: the fields show null (not reported).
BOOTED 0x64 (sysex.md 4.6.3): unsolicited, a HELLO reply's fields without the status byte.
